name: Meilisearch
description: Integrates Meilisearch as a fast, typo-tolerant search engine for your Jellyfin library. Features include real-time index synchronization with library changes and manual re-indexing.

versions.changelog: Initial release with search provider, real-time sync, and reindex task. Optional semantic search using a locally run Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B model, disabled by default.
